python3 -c "
import subprocess, time, sys

with open('expected.txt') as f:
    exp = [line.strip().split(',') for line in f if line.strip()]

small_in = b'id,cat,val\n10,z_cat,10.5\n2,a_cat,-3.25\n99,z_cat,1.25\n'
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'csvsum.py'], input=small_in, capture_output=True)
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout.decode().strip().splitlines() != ['a_cat,-3.25', 'z_cat,11.75']:
    print(0); sys.exit(0)

t_total = 0.0
runs = 0
while t_total < 0.25 and runs < 15:
    with open('data.csv', 'rb') as f:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'csvsum.py'], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
        t1 = time.perf_counter()
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print(0); sys.exit(0)
    if runs == 0:
        act = [line.strip().split(',') for line in p.stdout.decode().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if len(act) != len(exp):
            print(0); sys.exit(0)
        for (k1, v1), (k2, v2) in zip(act, exp):
            if k1 != k2 or len(v1.split('.')[1]) != 2 or abs(float(v1) - float(v2)) > 0.5:
                print(0); sys.exit(0)
    t_total += (t1 - t0)
    runs += 1

print(f'{runs * 2000000 / t_total:.1f}')
"
